github.reason: Keep the repository small and avoid consuming Actions/artifact/storage quota with binary media.

google_drive.role: optional private curated media library and archive; identifiers and URLs must be supplied outside version control
google_drive.configuration: private runtime configuration only; do not commit folder IDs or URLs

production_media.default: deterministic editorial card rendered by GitHub Actions
production_media.web_images: Only use a real external image when it materially improves the post and usage rights/source are clear. Never hotlink arbitrary search-result images.
